summary: Mammography and Ultrasound multimodal evaluation for patient P_SOUTENANCE_01 reveals suspicious focal parenchymal asymmetry with estimated malignancy probability of 0.74. ACR 4A suspicion warrants histopathological confirmation.
recommendations: Image-guided core needle biopsy (CNB) recommended per ACR BI-RADS 4A guidelines.
limitations: Artificial Intelligence diagnostic assistance system — not certified as autonomous diagnostic tool.
Must be reviewed and validated by a licensed radiologist before clinical intervention.

evidence.passage: [ACR BI-RADS Category 4B: Moderate Suspicion for Malignancy] ACR BI-RADS Category 4B: Moderate suspicion for malignancy. Malignancy risk range is > 10% to <= 50%. Includes amorphous or coarse heterogeneous calcifications, or solid mass with partially indistinct margins. Tissue diagnosis via image-guided biopsy is recommended.

[ACR BI-RADS Category 4A: Low Suspicion for Malignancy] ACR BI-RADS Category 4A: Low suspicion for malignancy. Malignancy risk range is > 2% to <= 10%. Includes partially circumscribed solid mass with ultrasound features suggestive of fibroadenoma, or solitary complicated cyst. Tissue sampling (core needle biopsy) is indicated, though benign pathology is expected.

[ACR BI-RADS Category 4C: High Suspicion for Malignancy] ACR BI-RADS Category 4C: High suspicion for malignancy. Malignancy risk range is > 50% to < 95%. Includes new cluster of fine pleomorphic calcifications or irregular solid mass with microlobulated or indistinct margins. Histopathological verification is mandatory.
